copy.unavailable: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the text above.

disclosure.folder: Prepare the required version yourself. Replace <folder/> with its folder path, check it, then save the location after review. Portcove does not download, copy, update, back up, or delete these files.
disclosure.installed: The CLI checks this installation before launching it. This does not install or update the game.
disclosure.setup: Running this command can download and install the selected release. Required game files are checked before use.
disclosure.staged: The CLI checks the retained staged version before making it active. This does not download a new release or register an external installation.
disclosure.userSelected: Complete upstream setup, then replace <executable/> and <workdir/> with your selected paths. Add documented arguments with one <arg/> per argument to both commands. You or the upstream launcher manage setup and updates; Portcove has not authenticated the selected bytes as an official package.

followUp.folder: After the folder check passes, review and save this installation. Its files stay where they are.
followUp.userSelected: After reviewing the executable, working directory and any <arg/> values, replace <review/> with the returned review fingerprint and save the same launch details. All external files stay where they are.

invalidPaths: Remove invalid characters from the selected paths before copying a command.
previewBeta: The command uses beta for the Preview channel. The selected CLI's preview input support has not been verified, so the copied command retains beta for compatibility.

separate.explanation: For integrations that accept a program path and an argument array. The shell command above is for a terminal.

template.replaceAndInstall: Template — replace: <names/>. Install the standalone Portcove CLI or locate its executable first.

title.setup: Set up from the command line
